decision.topic: Payment gateway ambiguous initiation failure and safe retry/reconciliation
decision.choice: C — explicit rejection permits retry; ambiguous timeout/transport failure blocks retry and requires reconciliation.
decision.notes: Implemented and verified locally: definitive rejection marks FAILED; ambiguous result retains INITIATED and blocks another attempt. Real provider/staging behavior remains unverified.

limitations: Mock/local gateway only; no real provider or staging verification.
Browser injects the ambiguous outcome at the API boundary; API persistence behavior is independently checked by isolated PostgreSQL E2E.
Repository remediation remains incomplete outside this local slice.
